_comment: Row 344. Run from a detached standalone scratch tree with: venv/bin/python toolchain/bin/bd-mutate --spec tests/mutants/row344_capture_prune_target_identity.json --work DETACHED_SCRATCH --timeout 300. M1 restores the demonstrated hard-coded /tmp deletion; the gate's PATH-local find maps that historical lookup into a same-named decoy inside tmp_path, so no real capture is reachable. M2-M4 prove unavailable root identity, archive ownership, and newest-retention direction. The companion transform control applies M1 byte-for-byte to a source-only node and must ESCAPE.
subject: bd_capture_prune is object-bound to the directory advertised by its glob

mutants.label: M1 restore the demonstrated hard-coded /tmp search and pathname rm
mutants.new:
local d n=0
  while IFS= read -r d; do
    n=$((n + 1))
    if [ "$n" -gt "$keep" ]; then
      rm -rf -- "$d" "${d}.tar.gz"
      printf 'pruned %s\n' "$d"
    fi
  done <<EOF
$(find /tmp -maxdepth 1 -name "$(basename "$glob")" -type d -printf '%T@ %p\n' 2>/dev/null \
    | sort -rn | cut -d' ' -f2-)
EOF
